audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Justice Punch as the matchup-defining cooldown but gives no actual cooldown number, and two Do/Don't bullets are the tradeGood/tradeBad lines copy-pasted under unrelated titles instead of explaining what their titles promise (mid-charge root timing, and playing around his Flash after E).
audit.why: Real cooldowns make the advice actionable — Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s, Zyra's Stranglethorns is 110/100/90s. Justice Punch also has a visible backstep windup before the dash that Grasping Roots can interrupt, and he can Flash mid- or post-taunt-dash to extend the catch, which the bleed text never mentions.
